None can arrive: backend/main.py:3446 does `body = payload.model_dump()` on SandboxTurnCreateRequest, which is extra="forbid" (backend/schemas.py:2579-2580) with no customerId and no enableTools field, and its optional context is SandboxContext, also extra="forbid" with only the nine render tokens (backend/schemas.py:2532-2543). main.py:3447-3450 then pops a null context. So `payload.get('enableTools')` is always None and SANDBOX_TEXT_TOOLS=true (backend/.env.example:378, read at backend/sandbox_runtime.py:190) short-circuits into an AND with an unreachable customer_id — the documented switch is inert. Only backend caller is main.py:3452; the tests call the function directly.

Half real, half unreachable. Real: backend/agent_core/turn.py:75-81 calls build_system_prompt with no channel, so it defaults to 'text' (backend/agent_core/prompt.py:145); 'text' is in _TEXT_CHANNELS (backend/agent_core/prompt.py:58), which drops the disclosure rule (backend/agent_core/prompt.py:74-75, is_text at :74, gate at :75) and injects 'never state a call-recording disclosure even if an instruction above tells you to always disclose one' (backend/agent_core/prompt.py:116-123). Reachable only by a hand-rolled POST /sandbox/runs with a custom openingTemplate (backend/schemas.py:2553-2562 accepts one). Downgraded to MINOR on the surviving parity half.

The cap is real: _HARD_MAX_TURNS defaults to 3 (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:366), effective_max = min(3, card.maxTurns) (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:712, re-checked under the row lock at :948), exceeding it raises sandbox_max_turns:3 → 409 (backend/main.py:3455-3456), evaluate_guardrails appends max-turns (backend/agent_core/guardrails.py:222-225) which should_halt treats as terminal (:251-263) and the run is written 'completed' (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:1039-1040) under a system turn reading 'Run halted · guardrail max-turns' (:1024). The frontend literal 3 is at Habibi/src/routes/sandbox.lazy.tsx:466, so raising SANDBOX_HARD_MAX_TURNS does desync the header. But the MAJOR claim is refuted by a guard the finding missed: the live text runtime DOES stop on max turns — backend/bot_runtime.py:851-864 computes max_turns = min(guardrails.maxTurns or _hard_max_turns(), _hard_max_turns()) (BOT_HARD_MAX_TURNS default 12, backend/bot_runtime.py:57-58) and escalates to a human plus cancels the job when turn_count exceeds it. Only the flag from the early evaluate_guardrails call (backend/bot_runtime.py:816-824) is discarded, not the enforcement. Also weakening 'a guardrail the operator did not configure': the header renders turnsUsed/turnsMax with turnsMax = min(3, maxTurns) from the first render (Habibi/src/routes/sandbox.lazy.tsx:464-468), so the 3-exchange cap is disclosed on screen. Residual real defect — no rehearsal past exchange 3, and a hardcoded 3 in the client — is MINOR.

Confirmed, with one sub-claim corrected. promote() posts the browser tuning state (Habibi/src/routes/sandbox.lazy.tsx:442-449). In publish_prompt_version, `if tuning is not None:` takes the 'Sandbox Promote — Tuning Studio payload is authoritative' branch (backend/db_prompt_studio.py:2002-2004) and skips the else branch's apply_voice_config_overlay (backend/db_prompt_studio.py:2005-2019); prompt_versions.tuning is then overwritten with the browser object (backend/db_prompt_studio.py:2020-2028). The consequence is real and MAJOR, but the biggest part is not prosody: since the panel is seeded only from voice (SANDBOX-07), promoting writes the browser DEFAULT llm/stt/vad/turn/interaction — temperature 0.4, idle 6.0 (Habibi/src/data/agent-tuning.ts:69-109) — over whatever the version had, and the runtime reads prosody from tuning.tts, not voice_config (backend/voice/bot.py:579-587 uses voiceConfig only for voiceName). Sub-claim to correct: rate and pitch are NOT lost — tuningFromVoiceConfig reproduces the server formulas (Habibi/src/data/agent-tuning.ts:255-257 vs backend/agent_core/tuning.py:394-400). What is genuinely lost is the provider `params` bag (only apply_voice_config_overlay sets tts['params'], backend/agent_core/tuning.py:387-388) and the warmth-derived style whenever the Voice tab carries an explicit style (client keeps voice.style with a fixed degree 1.4, Habibi/src/data/agent-tuning.ts:243-252; server always recomputes from warmth, backend/agent_core/tuning.py:402-409). The inert-slider claim holds: text turns read temperature from prompt_versions.tuning (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:763-770), never from the panel, while PromoteDialog advertises `temp ${tuning.llm.temperature}` (Habibi/src/routes/sandbox.lazy.tsx:659).

Verified. The live text runtime, on a successful load_skill, appends the skill body developer message and recomputes the offered list from the activated mouth (backend/bot_runtime.py:1023-1038). The sandbox loop computes `tools` once before the loop (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:214-218) and its tool-result branch only appends the serialized JSON (backend/sandbox_runtime.py:276-333); nothing re-derives tools or injects a body. _tool_load_skill deliberately strips the body — `{k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != 'message'} | {'body_loaded': True}` (backend/bot_tools.py:739-749) — because the caller is expected to inject it, so the sandbox model would receive the ok/body_loaded envelope and no instructions. Latent behind SANDBOX-01, as stated; MINOR stands.

Confirmed with the headline overstated. Dead surfaces are real: POST /sandbox/runs/{id}/complete (backend/main.py:3461-3463) has no client in Habibi/src — the only caller is the voice stop path (backend/voice_sandbox.py:238-249) — and useSandboxRun / fetchSandboxRun (Habibi/src/api/sandbox.ts:150, :170) have no component caller anywhere in Habibi/src (grep returns only their definitions), so the page renders only local `turns` state and the server-authoritative record (grounded chunk titles, guardrail flags, latency) is written and never read back. Reset and scenario change drop the run client-side with no server call (Habibi/src/routes/sandbox.lazy.tsx:209-217, :219-227). Orphan `running` rows come only from abandoned runs (reset, scenario change, page close before exchange 3), which is also what breaks the finding's own stated trigger. MINOR stands on the lost-transcript and orphan-row half.
